title: LS-MDRM Protocol Compliance Checker
description: Machine-executable compliance rules for trajectory records. Each rule has an id, description, check function signature, and expected behavior on violations.

checker_rules.description: For every transition node, B_n^selected must be a member of B_n^eligible.
checker_rules.check: assert selected_candidate in eligible_candidates for each branch_record

checker_rules.description: For every transition node, B_n^eligible must be a subset of B_n^raw.
checker_rules.check: assert all(c in raw_candidates for c in eligible_candidates) for each branch_record

checker_rules.description: Every raw candidate not in eligible must have at least one rejection code from the defined set.
checker_rules.check: assert len(rejections_for_candidate) >= 1 and all codes in valid_rejection_codes for each excluded raw candidate

checker_rules.description: BSR must equal |eligible| / |raw|. Computed value must match recorded value within float precision.
Every material claim must have an assigned status from the valid set.
checker_rules.check: assert claim_status in ['OBSERVED','DERIVED','HYPOTHESIZED','COUNTERFACTUAL','PROPOSED','UNRESOLVED'] for each ledger entry

checker_rules.description: Unlicensed promotions must be detected. A promotion from weaker to stronger status without promotion_licensed=true is unlicensed.
checker_rules.check: for each ledger entry where prior_claim_status != null and claim_status is stronger: assert promotion_licensed == true

checker_rules.description: Every evidence binding must contain artifact_id_or_path, repository_commit, and exact_location.
checker_rules.check: assert all required fields present and non-empty for each evidence_binding

checker_rules.description: Repository commit in evidence binding must equal the bound commit unless a specific historical override is documented.
checker_rules.check: assert repository_commit == BOUND_COMMIT or historical_override_documented == true
checker_rules.mutation_test: Substitute current main HEAD for bound commit; rule must trigger.

checker_rules.description: All four H components (H_s, H_g, H_r, H_c) must be present and independently recorded for every state.
checker_rules.check: assert H_s != null and H_g != null and H_r != null and H_c != null for each entropy_record

checker_rules.description: Entropy may not be collapsed into a single scalar. No single-value entropy summary replaces the four-component record.
checker_rules.check: assert no field named 'H_total' or 'H_combined' or 'entropy_scalar' exists without the four components also present

checker_rules.description: At least one uncertainty source must be documented per material state.
checker_rules.check: assert len(uncertainty_record.sources) >= 1 for each material state

checker_rules.description: A holdout fixture must follow SEALED → OPENED → CONSUMED. CONSUMED → SEALED is prohibited.
checker_rules.check: assert no holdout fixture has lifecycle_status=='SEALED' after having previously been 'CONSUMED'

checker_rules.description: Raw branch set must not be retrospectively modified. Hash of raw_candidates array at time of recording must match hash at time of evaluation.
checker_rules.mutation_test: Remove one raw candidate from the array; rule must trigger.

checker_rules.description: Scoring rubric rules must not be modified after fixture output is observed.
checker_rules.check: assert rubric version at evaluation matches rubric version at construction (compare schema hashes)
checker_rules.mutation_test: Change a scoring level after running a fixture; rule must trigger.

checker_rules.description: Blind evaluator packet must not contain desired_result, expected_direction, or generator_self_evaluation.
checker_rules.check: assert none of the prohibited fields are present in the evaluator_packet

checker_rules.description: Trajectory record must validate against LS_MDRM_STATE_DICTIONARY, LS_MDRM_BRANCH_PROTOCOL, and LS_MDRM_TRAJECTORY_SCHEMA.
